tcb_info.app_compose:
{
    "manifest_version": 2,
    "name": "dstack-0.5.12",
    "runner": "docker-compose",
    "docker_compose_file": "# Docker Compose configuration for Cloud API in a VPC environment
# This setup includes the dstack-service for VPC management and an init container
# to prepare necessary configuration files before starting the Cloud API service.

services:
  
  # OpenTelemetry collector sidecar for in-CVM logs/metrics/traces.
  otelcol-contrib:
    image: otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib@sha256:85ac41c2db88d0df9bd6145e608a3cb023f5d8443868adbfbbf66efb51087917
    container_name: otelcol-contrib
    command: ["--config=/etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml"]
    user: "0:0"
    mem_limit: "512m"
    environment:
      - MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN=${MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN}
      - CVM_NAME=${CVM_NAME}
      - CVM_HOST=${CVM_HOST}
      - DD_HOSTNAME=${DD_HOSTNAME}
      - ENV=${ENV}
      - CVM_HOSTMETRICS_ROOT_PATH=/hostfs
      
    expose:
      - "4317"
      - "4318"
    volumes:
      # Required for Prometheus docker_sd_configs. The scrape rules below only
      # keep containers explicitly labeled nearai.otel.scrape=true.
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      # Required for CVM guest hostmetrics parity. OTel prefixes host mount
      # points with root_path=/hostfs so the collector reports the guest host,
      # not the collector container filesystem.
      - /:/hostfs:ro
      - /var/lib/docker/containers:/var/lib/docker/containers:ro
      
      - otelcol-identity:/telemetry:ro
      
      - otelcol-storage:/var/lib/otelcol-contrib
    configs:
      - source: otelcol_cvm_config
        target: /etc/otelcol-contrib/config.yaml
        mode: 0444
    
    # Identity-enabled CVMs declare their startup prerequisites through

configs:
  
  # otelcol-contrib config for guest-level CVM telemetry. Dollar signs are
# escaped as $$ so docker compose leaves OTel's ${env:...} references intact.
  otelcol_cvm_config:
    content: |
      receivers:
        otlp:
          protocols:
            grpc:
              endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317
            http:
              endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4318

        filelog/docker_containers:
          include: [/var/lib/docker/containers/*/*-json.log]
          start_at: end
          storage: file_storage
          include_file_path: true
          operators:
            - type: json_parser
              parse_from: body
              parse_to: attributes
              timestamp:
                parse_from: attributes.time
                layout_type: gotime
                layout: '2006-01-02T15:04:05.999999999Z07:00'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: move
              from: attributes.log
              to: body
              if: 'attributes.log != nil'
            - type: move
              from: attributes.stream
              to: attributes["log.iostream"]
              if: 'attributes.stream != nil'
            - type: remove
              field: attributes.time
              if: 'attributes.time != nil'
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["log.file.path"]
              regex: '/var/lib/docker/containers/(?P<container_id>[a-f0-9]{12})[a-f0-9]*/'
              on_error: send_quiet
            # Preserve the low-cardinality Datadog autodiscovery tags operators
            # already use as log filters. High-cardinality tags like instance
            # and model_path stay inside the raw Docker label metadata.
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'model:(?P<model>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'deployment:(?P<deployment>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'ip:(?P<ip>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'port:(?P<port>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'env:(?P<env>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: regex_parser
              parse_from: attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"]
              regex: 'host:(?P<host>[^",\]]+)'
              on_error: send_quiet
            - type: add
              field: attributes["service.name"]
              value: cvm-docker

        hostmetrics/cvm:
          collection_interval: 30s
          root_path: $${env:CVM_HOSTMETRICS_ROOT_PATH}
          scrapers:
            cpu: {}
            memory: {}
            load: {}
            paging: {}
            network: {}
            disk: {}
            filesystem:
              exclude_mount_points:
                mount_points: ["^/dev(/.*)?$", "^/proc(/.*)?$", "^/sys(/.*)?$", "^/run(/.*)?$", "^/var/lib/docker(/.*)?$"]
                match_type: regexp

        docker_stats/cvm:
          endpoint: unix:///var/run/docker.sock
          collection_interval: 30s
          timeout: 10s
          api_version: "1.44"
          container_labels_to_metric_labels:
            com.docker.compose.service: compose_service
            com.docker.compose.project: compose_project

        prometheus/self:
          config:
            scrape_configs:
              - job_name: otelcol-cvm
                scrape_interval: 30s
                static_configs:
                  - targets: ['localhost:8888']
              - job_name: docker-labeled-services
                scrape_interval: 15s
                docker_sd_configs:
                  - host: unix:///var/run/docker.sock
                    refresh_interval: 30s
                relabel_configs:
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_scrape]
                    regex: "true"
                    action: keep
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_network_name]
                    regex: dstack_default
                    action: keep
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_port]
                    regex: ".+"
                    action: keep
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_network_ip, __meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_port]
                    separator: ":"
                    target_label: __address__
                    replacement: "$$1:$$2"
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_path]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: __metrics_path__
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_job]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: job
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_service]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: service
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_com_docker_compose_service]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: container_name
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_model]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: model
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_deployment]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: deployment
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_env]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: env
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_host]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: host
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_ip]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: ip
                  - source_labels: [__meta_docker_container_label_nearai_otel_port]
                    regex: "(.+)"
                    target_label: port
              
        

      processors:
        memory_limiter:
          check_interval: 1s
          limit_mib: 256
          spike_limit_mib: 64

        resource:
          attributes:
            - key: host.name
              value: $${env:DD_HOSTNAME}
              action: upsert
            - key: cvm.name
              value: $${env:CVM_NAME}
              action: upsert
            - key: host.machine
              value: $${env:CVM_HOST}
              action: insert
            - key: deployment.environment
              value: $${env:ENV}
              action: upsert
            - key: service.namespace
              value: near-ai
              action: insert

        
        resource/cvm_instance:
          attributes:
            - key: cvm.instance.id
              value: $${file:/telemetry/instance_id}
              action: upsert

        # dstack-vpc-client writes instance_id with echo, so strip its trailing
        # newline before Prometheus converts cvm.instance.id to cvm_instance_id.
        transform/cvm_instance:
          error_mode: propagate
          metric_statements:
            - replace_pattern(resource.attributes["cvm.instance.id"], "\\s+$", "")
            - delete_key(resource.attributes, "cvm.instance.id") where resource.attributes["cvm.instance.id"] == "unavailable"
          log_statements:
            - context: resource
              statements:
                - replace_pattern(attributes["cvm.instance.id"], "\\s+$", "")
                - delete_key(attributes, "cvm.instance.id") where attributes["cvm.instance.id"] == "unavailable"
          trace_statements:
            - context: resource
              statements:
                - replace_pattern(attributes["cvm.instance.id"], "\\s+$", "")
                - delete_key(attributes, "cvm.instance.id") where attributes["cvm.instance.id"] == "unavailable"
        

        transform/docker_metadata:
          error_mode: ignore
          log_statements:
            - context: log
              statements:
                - set(attributes["service.name"], attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"] != nil
                - set(attributes["service.name"], ParseJSON(attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"])[0]["service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil
                - set(attributes["log.source"], ParseJSON(attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"])[0]["source"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.datadoghq.ad.logs"] != nil
                - set(attributes["container.name"], attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"]) where attributes["attrs"] != nil and attributes["attrs"]["com.docker.compose.service"] != nil

        groupbyattrs/docker_service:
          keys:
            - service.name
            - container.name
            - log.source
            - log.iostream
            - model
            - deployment
            - env
            - host
            - ip
            - port

        batch:
          send_batch_size: 1024
          send_batch_max_size: 2048
          timeout: 5s

      exporters:
        otlphttp/gateway:
          endpoint: https://telemetry.infra.near.ai
          headers:
            Authorization: "Bearer $${env:MONITORING_INGEST_TOKEN}"
          # Keep source requests FIFO. The Collector default is ten queue
          # consumers; once they reorder cumulative samples, the gateway's
          # serialized remote-write queue cannot restore their order.
          sending_queue:
            num_consumers: 1
            queue_size: 128
            storage: file_storage
        

      extensions:
        file_storage:
          directory: /var/lib/otelcol-contrib/storage
          create_directory: true

      service:
        extensions: [file_storage]
        pipelines:
          logs/cvm:
            receivers: [filelog/docker_containers]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, resource/cvm_instance, transform/cvm_instance, transform/docker_metadata, groupbyattrs/docker_service, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          metrics/cvm_system:
            receivers: [hostmetrics/cvm, docker_stats/cvm]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, resource/cvm_instance, transform/cvm_instance, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          logs/otlp:
            receivers: [otlp]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, resource/cvm_instance, transform/cvm_instance, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          metrics/self:
            receivers: [prometheus/self]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, resource/cvm_instance, transform/cvm_instance, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          
          metrics/otlp:
            receivers: [otlp]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, resource/cvm_instance, transform/cvm_instance, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
          traces:
            receivers: [otlp]
            processors: [memory_limiter, resource, resource/cvm_instance, transform/cvm_instance, batch]
            exporters: [otlphttp/gateway]
        telemetry:
          metrics:
            address: localhost:8888
          logs:
            level: info


  api_init_script:
    content: |
      #!/bin/sh
      set -e

      echo "Cloud API initialization starting..."

      # Wait for file to exist in /shared
      echo "Waiting for /shared/shared_key to exist..."
      while [ ! -f /shared/shared_key ]; do
        sleep 2
      done
      echo "/shared/shared_key exists"

      # Stage only the canonical dstack identity into separate app and collector
      # volumes. Neither consumer receives the credential-bearing VPC volume.
      INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_ATTEMPTS=$${INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_ATTEMPTS:-60}
      INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_SECONDS=$${INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_SECONDS:-2}
      echo "Waiting for /shared/instance_id to exist..."
      for _ in $$(seq 1 "$$INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_ATTEMPTS"); do
        if [ -s /shared/instance_id ]; then
          break
        fi
        sleep "$$INSTANCE_ID_WAIT_SECONDS"
      done
      if [ ! -s /shared/instance_id ]; then
        echo "dstack instance identity was not staged" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      INSTANCE_ID=$$(sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$$//' /shared/instance_id)
      if [ -z "$$INSTANCE_ID" ]; then
        echo "dstack instance identity is empty after trimming" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      umask 077
      printf '%s' "$$INSTANCE_ID" > /app-identity/instance_id
      printf '%s' "$$INSTANCE_ID" > /telemetry/instance_id
      chmod 0444 /app-identity/instance_id /telemetry/instance_id
      unset INSTANCE_ID

      echo "Copying shared key to /config/keyfile..."
      cp /shared/shared_key /config/keyfile
      chmod 644 /config/keyfile

      # Decode only inside the CVM; never place raw credentials in Compose.
      # RDS material is independent of the unchanged VPC-derived encryption keys.
      umask 077
      if ! printf '%s' "$${CLOUD_API_RDS_PASSWORD_B64:?}" | base64 -d > /config/postgres-password; then
        echo "Invalid RDS password encoding" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      if ! printf '%s' "$${CLOUD_API_RDS_CA_BUNDLE_B64:?}" | base64 -d > /config/rds-ca-bundle.pem; then
        echo "Invalid RDS CA bundle encoding" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      test -s /config/postgres-password
      test -s /config/rds-ca-bundle.pem
      chown 1000:1000 /config/postgres-password /config/rds-ca-bundle.pem
      chmod 600 /config/postgres-password /config/rds-ca-bundle.pem
      unset CLOUD_API_RDS_PASSWORD_B64 CLOUD_API_RDS_CA_BUNDLE_B64

      echo "Copying actual hostname to /config/vpc_hostname..."
      cp /shared/actual_hostname /config/vpc_hostname
      chmod 644 /config/vpc_hostname

      # Derive S3 encryption key (32 bytes) from keyfile
      # Read 32 raw bytes, which are then converted to a 64-character hex string.
      S3_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(head -c 32 /config/keyfile | xxd -p | tr -d '\n')
      echo "$$S3_ENCRYPTION_KEY" > /config/s3-encryption-key
      chmod 644 /config/s3-encryption-key

      # Derive a distinct database field-encryption key from the same VPC root
      # secret. The fixed domain label prevents reuse of the S3 key material;
      # the NUL delimiter is part of the versioned derivation. sha256sum emits
      # the 64 lowercase hex characters expected by cloud-api. Never log it.
      umask 077
      {
        printf 'nearai-cloud-api/database-field-encryption/v1\000'
        cat /config/keyfile
      } | sha256sum | awk '{print $$1}' > /config/database-encryption-key
      # cloud-api runs as UID/GID 1000 and mounts api_config read-only.
      chown 1000:1000 /config/database-encryption-key
      chmod 600 /config/database-encryption-key

      echo "Initialization complete"

",
